headline: Indian Equities Fall as High Oil Prices Impact Sentiment
summary: India's stock market fell as Brent crude traded over $114 per barrel, pushing major indices and sectors into losses.
why: India is the world's third-largest importer of crude, making its equity markets highly sensitive to rising global energy costs.

impacts.name: BSE SENSEX
impacts.why: Surging import costs for crude oil squeeze corporate margins and weaken broader investor sentiment in import-dependent economies.

why_moved: High crude oil prices increase inflationary pressures and import bills for India, negatively impacting corporate earnings expectations and driving down equity indices.
